reasoning: The May meeting marks a material escalation in policy tools and pace: the Fed shifted from a 25bp hike to a 50bp hike, formally launched balance sheet runoff with specific caps ($30B/$60B Treasuries, $17.5B/$35B MBS), and added 'The Committee is highly attentive to inflation risks'—a new explicit reaction-function signal. While the broad tightening direction was already set in March, activating QT and doubling the hike pace constitutes a substantive regime shift in dominant tool deployment and trajectory.
